create_collator_default: create a default data collator that batches dict features and converts lists and arrays to tensors
create_collator_padding: create a DataCollatorWithPadding that pads sequences to the same length within a batch using a tokenizer
create_collator_seq2seq: create a DataCollatorForSeq2Seq that pads both input sequences and labels for encoder-decoder models
create_collator_mlm: create a DataCollatorForLanguageModeling that masks tokens for masked language modeling or shifts labels for causal language modeling
create_collator_token_classification: create a DataCollatorForTokenClassification that pads input_ids and labels using -100 as the default label padding value
